αἰγιόχοιο: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing, epithet of Zeus (meaning disputed, usually ’holding the αἰγίς’); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
αἰνείας: Αἰνείας — Aeneas, a Trojan leader, son of Anchises; masc. nom. sg.
αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl.: ’they’; αἳ μέν … αἳ δέ ’some … others’
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἴσῃ: αἶσα — portion, lot, fate; fem. dat. sg.: ’by an evil lot’ (κακῇ αἴσῃ)
αἷμ: αἷμα — blood; neut. acc. sg., elided (αἷμ’ = αἷμα)
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately; adv.
αὐτοῖο: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic αὐτοῦ): ’him’, after πάροιθε ’before him’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
βέλος: βέλος — missile, shaft, arrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ’good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός)
βοὸς: βοῦς — ox, cow; gen. sg.: ’of an ox’
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
βῆσε: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 3 sg. causative, unaugmented (= ἔβησε): ’made go aboard, embarked’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. (ἁλίοιο γέροντος ’of the old man of the sea’)
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γήραϊ: γῆρας — old age; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γήρᾳ), dative of cause: ’by old age’
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
γυῖα: γυῖον — limb; neut. acc. pl., object of ἔλλαβε · also neut. acc. pl., object of λῦσε: ’loosed the limbs’ (λῦσε δὲ γυῖα)
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δέξατο: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδέξατο)
δίφρῳ: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. dat. sg.
δίῳ: δῖος — bright, noble, divine (epic epithet); masc. dat. sg.
δαΐφρων: δαΐφρων — of uncertain sense, either ’warlike’ or ’wise-minded’; masc. nom. sg., epithet in apposition to a name
δεξιὸν: δεξιός — on the right, right; masc. acc. sg., with ὦμον
δευοίατο: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= Attic -οιντο): ’would lack’
δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
διομήδης: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’)
διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg. Διί
δουρί: δόρυ — spear, shaft; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δόρατι)
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δὸς: δίδωμι — give; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; neut. acc. sg.
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom
εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν) — in, among; prep. + dat.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’)
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εὐχόμενος: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, boast; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’praying’ · also ’boasting’, of a claim
εὔχεται: εὔχομαι — claim, boast, profess; pres. 3 sg.: ’claims (to be)’ · also pray, + dat.: ’prays’ (Διὶ δ’ εὔχεται ’and to Zeus he prays’)
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θεός: θεός — god; nom. sg. (also ’goddess’, θεός being common gender)
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., subject: ’the god’ (common gender; may also name a goddess) · also masc. nom. sg. in a comparison: ’(like) a god’ (θεὸς ὣς)
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θώρηκος: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. gen. sg., epic θώρηκ- (= Attic θώρακος)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ (κάρη κομόωντας ’long-haired’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’head’ (κάρη ὤμοισιν ἐπείη ’may the head be on the shoulders’) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’head’ (ἐστήριξε κάρη ’planted her head’)
κάτα: κατά — down; adv./preverb standing after its verb in tmesis (anastrophe): ἔχεν κάτα = κατεῖχεν ’held down’
κέρδιον: κερδίων — more profitable, better; neut. nom. sg., comparative (κέρδος), predicate
καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, down to; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing (καθ’ ἕδρας ’down to their seats’) · also + acc., ’through, throughout’ (καθ’ ὕλην ’through the wood’)
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’evils’
κακῇ: κακός — bad, evil; fem. dat. sg.
κακῶς: κακός — bad, evil; adv.: ’wickedly, shamefully’ · also ’miserably, in misery’ (ὀψὲ κακῶς ἔλθοι ’may he come late, in misery’)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’)
κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’fame’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a report’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’fame, a good name’ (κλέος … ἄροιτο ’win fame’)
κλῦθί: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg., + gen.: ’hear me!’
κρατέει: κρατέω — be strong; rule, + gen. ’over’; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= κρατεῖ)
κρατερόν: κρατερός — strong, mighty; adj., masc. acc. sg.
κρατερὰς: κρατερός — strong, mighty, stubborn; fem. acc. pl.
κρατερὸς: κρατερός — mighty, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg.
λάβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαβε); λαβεῖν + gen. ’take hold of’
λίπον: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔλιπον)
λαμπρὸν: λαμπρός — bright, shining; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’brightly’
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
λευκὸν: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. sg.
λυγρὰ: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, miserable; neut. acc. pl.: ’grievous things’
λυκάονος: Λυκάων — Lycaon, father of Pandarus; masc. gen. sg. · also Lycaon, a son of Priam and brother of Paris; masc. gen. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’)
μάχην: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg., object of καταδύμεναι: ’the fighting’
μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε · also fem. gen. sg., governed by εἰδότε: ’skilled in all (fighting)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἔσχοντο: ’from the fighting’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντιβολῆσαι: ’to meet (the battle)’
μέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg. μέ, accented because an enclitic follows: ’me’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’)
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg.
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj.
μαζοῖο: μαζός — breast, nipple; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεμαὼς: μέμαα (μάω) — strive, be eager; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., epic, present sense (no Attic equivalent): ’eager’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic (= Attic μου); κλῦθί μευ ’hear me’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’
μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg., correlative of τοῖος (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also neut. acc. sg. in an indirect exclamation: ’what (a thing)’ (οἷον ἔειπε ’what he said’)
οἷς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’ · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. dat. pl.: ’to whom’ (οἷς … μέλει ’to whom … is a care’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάνδαρον: Πάνδαρος — Pandarus, Lycian archer, son of Lycaon; masc. acc. sg.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα)
παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, a title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’)
παρέστης: παρίστημι — stand beside, come up to; aor. 2 sg. act. (root aorist): ’you have come to stand by’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’)
πατρώϊον: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, ancestral; neut. acc. sg.
πεζὸς: πεζός — on foot; adj., masc. nom. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
πολέμῳ: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. dat. sg.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
που: που — somewhere, anywhere; perhaps, I suppose; enclitic adv.
πρίν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv.; and conj. + inf., ’before’; πρὶν … πρίν ’not … until’
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρόσθ: πρόσθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., elided πρόσθ’ (= πρόσθε): ’before (the others)’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’)
σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison: ’than you’ · also possessive gen.: ’your’
σθένελος: Σθένελος — Sthenelus, son of Capaneus; masc. nom. sg.
σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); fem. acc. pl.
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σφεας: σφεῖς — they; epic acc. pl. pron. (= Attic σφᾶς): ’them’
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σύ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated)
τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg.
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. acc. sg. · also relative, ’whom, which’; accented before an enclitic
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’)
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
τυδεΐδῃ: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. dat. sg. (patronymic)
τόξα: τόξον — bow; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single bow)
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much, so greatly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’so many’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’)
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’)
υἱέας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἱέας (= Attic υἱούς/υἱεῖς)
υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
υἷε: υἱός — son; masc. nom. dual: ’two sons’
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’dear’ (φίλα τέκνα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as adverb: φίλα φρονέων ’kindly disposed’
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φαεινῷ: φαεινός — shining, bright, radiant; masc./neut. dat. sg.
φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φὼς: φώς — man; masc. nom. sg. (epic, φωτός in the gen.)
χάριν: χάρις — grace, favour, thanks; fem. acc. sg.: ’thanks’
χαλκήρεϊ: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze (χαλκός + ἀραρίσκω); adj. of two endings, dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.
χαμᾶζε: χαμᾶζε — to the ground, down to earth; adv. (χαμαί + -δε)
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χρομίον: Χρόμιος — Chromius, a Pylian captain; masc. acc. sg.
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὸς: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλῃσι: ἀλλήλων — one another; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἀλλήλαις)
ἀμείνων: ἀμείνων — better, stronger; masc. nom. sg., comparative of ἀγαθός
ἀμφοτέρω: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. acc. dual, agreeing with a dual noun: ’both’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμύμονά: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent; adj., masc. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
ἀνεμώλια: ἀνεμώλιος — windy, idle, vain (of words); neut. acc. pl.
ἀντίθεον: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. acc. sg.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — opposite, face to face; adv. or prep. + gen.: ’in opposition to, to the face of’
ἀντικρὺ: ἀντικρύ — straight through, right through; adv. (epic, = ἀντικρύς)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀριστήεσσιν: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief; masc. dat. pl., epic -ήεσσιν (= Attic -εῦσιν)
ἀτρεΐδῃ: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic, of Agamemnon); masc. dat. sg.
ἀτρυτώνη: Ἀτρυτώνη — Atrytone, cult-title of Athena, traditionally ’the Unwearied’, though the derivation is uncertain; fem. voc. sg.
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀφροδίτη: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. nom. sg.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλλοις: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. dat. pl.: ’(to) the others’
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency; with the subj. = future contingency, ’perhaps, may’ · also with the opt., potential: ’would, could’ (οὐκ ἄν τι φέροις ’you could not carry off anything’) · also ὅτ’ ἄν + subj., ’whenever’ (= ὅταν)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἆλτο: ἅλλομαι — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. mid., athematic, epic (= Attic ἥλατο): ’sprang’
ἐΐσκω: ἐΐσκω — liken, compare; pres. 1 sg. act., + dat. of what it is likened to
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξαῦτις: ἐξαῦτις — again, once more, anew; adv., epic (= Attic αὖθις)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’)
ἐπέτελλε: ἐπιτέλλω — lay charge on, enjoin (+ dat. + inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’laid charge’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’)
ἐρατεινὴν: ἐρατεινός — lovely, delightful; adj., fem. acc. sg.
ἐρεπτόμενοι: ἐρέπτομαι — feed on, munch; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., + acc.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσύλα: συλάω — strip off, take away; impf. 3 sg.: ’stripped off’
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, think; impf. mid. 1 sg. (= Attic ἔφην): ’I said, I thought’
ἐφεύροι: ἐφευρίσκω — find, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a general relative clause: ’whom he might find’ · also after εἴ που, of a hoped-for search: ’if she might find’
ἐόντας: εἰμί — be; pres. part. acc. pl. masc., epic (= Attic ὄντας)
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἔβαλε: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’struck, hit’
ἔγχεος: ἔγχος — spear; neut. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἔγχους)
ἔγωγ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε, elided (ἔγωγ’ = ἔγωγε): ’I for my part’
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔδμεναι: ἔδω — eat; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐσθίειν): ’to eat’
ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ν-movable): ’put, placed’ · also ’made, caused’, with a predicate acc. or a dat.
ἔκλυε: κλύω — hear, hearken to, heed; aor. 3 sg. (+ gen. of person heard)
ἔμελλον: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 pl. · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I was destined, was about to’ + fut. inf.
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί)
ἔοργε: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; perf. 3 sg. act. ἔοργε (from ἔρδω): ’has done’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕλεν: αἱρέω — take, seize; in battle, kill; aor. 2 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic εἷλεν)
ἕλον: αἱρέω — take; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλον); ἐκ … ἕλον in tmesis ’picked out’
ἕστηκ: ἵστημι — set; perf. stand; perf. 3 sg., elided (ἕστηκ’ = ἕστηκε): ’stands’
ἕτερον: ἕτερος — the other (of two), one; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόδα · also masc. acc. sg., in apposition to a dual noun: ’(the) one’ (ἄρνε … ἕτερον ’of the two lambs, one’)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠελίοιο: ἥλιος — sun; masc. gen. sg., epic ἠελίοιο (= Attic ἡλίου)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱππότα: ἱππότα — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α (= ἱππότης)
ἱσταμένη: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. stand, come to stand; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’coming to stand, standing’
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’this’
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’)
ὑσμίνας: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. acc. pl.
ὠκὺ: ὠκύς — swift, quick; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’)
ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
